title: Normal power-series cover of an adically formally smooth local algebra
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a local homomorphism of commutative Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_A,\mathfrak m_B$. Assume $\widehat A$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], $B$ is formally smooth over $A$ for the $\mathfrak m_B$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], $\dim B>\dim A$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], the induced residue-field extension is finite, and $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak m_AB$ is prime. There exist a complete Noetherian normal local domain $(C,\mathfrak n)$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], an integer $d\ge0$, and a faithfully flat local homomorphism $\iota:B\to D=C[[T_1,\ldots,T_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series, def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], such that $D$ is a Noetherian normal local domain and $\iota^{-1}(\mathfrak nD)=\mathfrak p$. Local means that the inverse image of the target maximal ideal is the source maximal ideal.

source.place: EGA IV4 proof of Theorem 21.14.1, first paragraph: completion, finite flat coefficient extension, a local factor D_0 and its power-series presentation; EGA 0_IV 19.3.6, 19.6.4, 19.7.1.5 and IV 7.5.1, 7.5.3, 6.5.4(ii). No Stacks tag asserts this combined cover. EGA IV4 is WANTED locally; read the online English translation.

proof.text: Put $A_0=\widehat A$ and $R=\widehat B$. The completion-local-ring and completion-Noetherian theorems give complete Noetherian local rings, with the original residue fields $k,l$ and maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_AA_0,\mathfrak m_BR$; completeness is supplied by the module-completion theorem with the finite ideals $\mathfrak m_A,\mathfrak m_B$. The completed map $A_0\to R$ is local: its residue map is the injective field map $k\to l$, so membership in the maximal ideal is detected on residues. It is adically formally smooth by [lem-weil-pbc-fs-adic-complete-source-target]. Also $B\to R$ is faithfully flat by [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-faithfully-flat].

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-complete-local-regular] to $A_0\to R$. Its fibres are geometrically regular, hence regular by taking the trivial purely inseparable extension in [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], hence normal by [lem-weil-pbc-regular-ring-normal]. The map is flat and both rings are Noetherian. Since $A_0$ is normal by hypothesis, [lem-weil-pbc-flat-normal-fibres-noetherian-normal] gives normality of $R$. A normal local ring is a normal domain: localization at its unique maximal ideal is the ring itself, so apply [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Thus we may use $C=R$ as a complete normal coefficient domain.

source.place: 21.14.1, normality of the coefficient ring: repair using C=completed B; Stacks 07PM (proposition-fs-regular), 0567 (lemma-regular-normal), 0C22 (lemma-normal-goes-up-noetherian).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-formally-smooth-completed-local-tensor-square] to $A_0\to R$, whose finite residue extension and formal smoothness were checked in step 1. Obtain the explicitly constructed complete local ring $E$, maps $j_1,j_2:R\to E$ and multiplication retraction $\mu:E\to R$. Regard $E$ as a $C=R$-algebra through $j_2$, with $\mathfrak n=\mathfrak m_R$. Both $j_i$ are faithfully flat local maps, induce the identity on $l$, and are adically formally smooth; $\mu j_2=\mathrm{id}_C$. This replaces the source's finite coefficient extension, whose asserted normality does not follow in the inseparable residue case (counterexample in report).

source.place: 21.14.1, tensor-product local-factor paragraph, repaired by EGA 0_I 7.7 and 0_IV 19.3.5--19.3.6 at the diagonal residue point.

proof.text: Set $I=\ker\mu$. Since $E$ is Noetherian, $I$ has finitely many generators; their images span the finite-dimensional $l$-vector space $I/\mathfrak m_EI$. Choose an $l$-basis and representatives $x_1,\ldots,x_d\in I$, allowing $d=0$. The retraction makes $j_2$ injective. Apply [lem-sfb-split-local-power-series-section-criterion] with coefficient ring $C$, target $E$, inclusion $j_2$ and retraction $\mu$. It gives $S=C[[T_1,\ldots,T_d]]$, complete Noetherian local with residue $l$, a local continuous $C$-map $\phi:S\to E$, and surjections $\phi_n:S/\mathfrak m_S^n\twoheadrightarrow E/\mathfrak m_E^n$ inducing the identity on $l$ for all $n\ge1$.

source.place: 21.14.1, power-series presentation; the split section criterion is Stacks 06SG (lemma-power-series), valid also in mixed characteristic.

proof.text: For $n\ge1$ put $U=S/\mathfrak m_S^n$ and $K=\ker\phi_n$. Since $\phi_n$ preserves residues, $K\subset\mathfrak m_SU$ and $K^n=0$. Start with the quotient $C$-map $E\to U/K=E/\mathfrak m_E^n$. For $t=1,\ldots,n-1$ lift through $U/K^{t+1}\twoheadrightarrow U/K^t$ using [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic] for $j_2$. The kernel is square zero, since $2t\ge t+1$; continuity holds at each stage because the map is local into a ring whose maximal ideal has nilpotence exponent at most $n$. Each lift remains local, as its reduction to $l$ is the identity. The resulting $C$-map $g:E\to U$ kills $\mathfrak m_E^n$ by locality, so gives $\sigma_n:E/\mathfrak m_E^n\to U$ with $\phi_n\sigma_n=\mathrm{id}$. For $n=1$ the residue identity itself is the section. The section clause of [lem-sfb-split-local-power-series-section-criterion] now makes $\phi$ a $C$-algebra isomorphism. Take $D=S$ and $\iota=\phi^{-1}j_1(B\to R)$.

source.place: 21.14.1, power-series step; explicit square-zero lifts realizing EGA 0_IV 19.7.1.5 in this split situation, via Stacks 06SG.

proof.text: The map $j_2:C\to E$ is adically formally smooth between complete Noetherian local rings. Reapply [lem-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-complete-local-regular]. As in step 2, its geometrically regular fibres are regular and normal, and [lem-weil-pbc-flat-normal-fibres-noetherian-normal] gives normality of $E$ from that of $C$. Since $E$ is local, [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] makes it a normal domain. Transporting through $\phi$ proves that $D$ is a Noetherian normal local domain. The composite $\iota$ is local. It is faithfully flat: the two maps $B\to R$ and $j_1:R\to E$ are faithfully flat; under $N\otimes_B E\cong(N\otimes_B R)\otimes_R E$, the two successive tensor functors preserve and reflect exactness, which is exactly [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. Ring isomorphisms preserve this condition.

source.place: 21.14.1, normality and faithful-flatness conclusion; Stacks 07PM, 0567, 0C22, and definition 00HB.

proof.text: Let $J=j_2(\mathfrak n)E$. The last clause of [lem-sfb-formally-smooth-completed-local-tensor-square] says that $R/\mathfrak m_{A_0}R\to E/J$ induced by $j_1$ is faithfully flat. By [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ideal-contraction], with ideal zero, it is injective. Thus $j_1^{-1}(J)=\mathfrak m_{A_0}R=\mathfrak m_AR$. Applying that same ideal-contraction theorem to $B\to R$ and $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak m_AB$ gives the inverse image in $B$ equal to $\mathfrak p$. Since $\phi$ is a $C$-algebra isomorphism, $\phi(\mathfrak nD)=J$. Therefore $\iota^{-1}(\mathfrak nD)=\mathfrak p$, as required. The construction actually does not need the positive dimension difference or the separately assumed primality; it proves the stated instance without changing its hypotheses.

source.place: 21.14.1, contraction (m D_0) cap B = m B, repaired by faithful flatness of the completed closed-fibre map; Stacks 05CK (lemma-faithfully-flat-universally-injective).

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q102-3ce5e7bf4 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Ordinary first split, not a re-split: the item was created 2026-10-24 by Q87 and has no repair note. Statement and stmt_deps unchanged. New node lem-sfb-formally-smooth-completed-local-tensor-square, verified true: q=ker(R⊗_A R→l) is finitely generated, so the completion E of P_q is Noetherian with E/m^n=P_q/q^n (05GG/05GH). Formal smoothness over each factor follows by lifting along the other factor and extending through the localization and the completion (q^{2N}→0). Flatness from 07NP. mu extends to E because R is complete. The closed fibre E/J is the completion of ((R/m_A R)⊗_k l)_r because all P_q/q^n have finite length (Mittag-Leffler), so R/m_A R→E/J is faithfully flat. It is not a restatement (no normality or power-series content) and no DAG duplicate was found (complete-local-smooth-power-series is over a field). Item steps 1-7 check against the full statements of the cited nodes. Stacks 07PM, 0C22, 07NP, 07EG, 07ED read in the local tex. Split criterion: all hypotheses supplied by j2 and mu. Step 5: K^n=0 and K^{2t}⊂K^{t+1}; locality gives continuity and phi_n sigma_n=id. Step 7: zero-ideal contraction plus contraction along B→R gives iota^{-1}(nD)=p. Source error: EGA IV4 is absent locally, so I could not read 21.14.1 myself; I re-derived the worker's counterexample independently (k=F2(a), y^2+ax^2+z^3 is normal; after adjoining sqrt(a) it becomes a cusp times a line). The repaired route C=B-hat is correct either way. Minor note: step 2 leaves the 'normal domain implies normal ring' step for A-hat tacit (elementary). Batch 5: lem-trf-vector-space-quotient-dimension is the Mathlib rank-nullity leaf, general linear algebra outside the trace formula and Poincare duality assumptions, so accepted. The nine declared sec-proper-base-change commutative-algebra tool_uses are accepted as black-box uses. No changes.

lean.statement: theorem exists_normal_powerSeries_cover_of_formallySmoothAdic (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B] [Algebra A B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)] [IsDomain (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)] [IsIntegrallyClosed (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)] (hfs : FormallySmoothAdic A B (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)) (hdim : ringKrullDim A < ringKrullDim B) [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)] (hp : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A B)).IsPrime) : ∃ (C : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : IsLocalRing C), IsNoetherianRing C ∧ IsDomain C ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed C ∧ IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C) C ∧ ∃ (d : ℕ) (_ : Algebra B (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) C)), Module.FaithfullyFlat B (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) C) ∧ IsLocalHom (algebraMap B (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) C)) ∧ IsNoetherianRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) C) ∧ IsDomain (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) C) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) C) ∧ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C).map (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin d))).comap (algebraMap B (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) C)) = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A B)

Conclusion: exists C : Type (max u v), complete Noetherian normal local domain, exists d and Algebra B (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) C), faithfully flat, IsLocalHom, Noetherian normal domain, and the comap of m_C extended along MvPowerSeries.C equals m_A B. Same quantifier order, nothing stronger. Edge cases d=0, zero ring, inseparable residues and universes are fine. All 8 stmt_deps are used and all imports exist.
